name: – After § 83 – Am 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2024 in Baku, Azerbaijan (COP29)
part_text: 83a. Calls on the Commission to urgently review the regulation on CO2 emissions performance for cars and vans with the objective of lifting the 2035 ban on petrol and diesel cars and adopting a technologically neutral approach that considers not only e-fuels but also biofuels and technology such as plug-in hybrid motors;
